Fast FWL evaluation of an omitted confounder

Source: R/covariance.R
evaluate_confounder.Rd

The function accepts either evaluate_confounder(cache, z, ...) or evaluate_confounder(y, d, X, z, ...).

Usage

evaluate_confounder(
  y,
  d = NULL,
  X = NULL,
  z = NULL,
  vcov = "HC1",
  cluster = NULL,
  null = 0
)

Arguments

y

An rv_cache or outcome vector.

d

Treatment vector, or z when y is an rv_cache.

X

Control matrix.

z

Confounder vector or matrix.

vcov

One of "classical", "HC0", "HC1", "CR0", or "CR1".

cluster

Optional one-way cluster labels.

null

Null coefficient value.
